primaryQuery: Nepali typing short long vowel matra
searchIntent: Get the intended short or long vowel sign (ि or ी, ु or ू) in a Nepali word typed with Roman letters, and check it before copying.
originalValue: Ten current-engine checks show where the first result uses the short sign, which suggestions offer the long one, and which alternative Roman spellings (ee, double ii) produced the long form for these words. One sentence typed two ways shows the difference in context. A cited dictionary-edition change (ठीक to ठिक) explains why the page names no single correct form. No spelling rule, spell checker or universal Roman mapping is claimed. 2026-11-26 revision adds where to copy each sign on its own (no Roman spelling gave a bare sign; pasted Devanagari passes through) and a syllable-row check: gha and bha rows came out right, ti and khii did not and are fixed from the suggestions; the ka row needs All Nepali.
overlapReview: The practice article checks one missing ा in बिहान; it does not address ि/ी or ु/ू length. The chandrabindu article covers nasal marks; the conjunct article covers halant joins; the Romanized comparison and mixed-language articles cover word ambiguity such as पानी/पनि and keeping English words. The typing guide explains suggestion controls without vowel-length examples. This page adds a vowel-length check with fresh food, family, travel and taste examples and a dictionary-edition caveat. No beginner guide or broad tool intent repeated.

keywordEvidence.note: Exact query has no measured volume. The November 1 Keyword Planner report (Google, Nepal, English, October 2025–September 2026, 395 ideas) has no vowel-length keyword; no range from it is assigned to this long tail. A historical 2013 reader question on the Nepali Language Resource Center spell-checker FAQ about ठीक versus ठिक is qualitative evidence that readers meet vowel-length questions, not current demand. 2026-11-26 revision: Search Console (Oct 28–Nov 24) shows 15 impressions over three bare vowel-sign queries (ी, ु, ू) at average positions 8–10 (see research); sparse, not a volume measure.

research.note: Nepali Language Resource Center spell-checker FAQ (HTTP 200). A reader asked why ठीक became flagged; the answer says earlier editions of the official dictionary listed the dirgha form ठीक and later editions list only the hrasva form ठिक, and guesses this follows a Nepal Academy change. Supports the caveat that the accepted vowel length can depend on the reference edition. The page does not name the edition; no edition number claimed.
Primary character names for the Devanagari vowel signs: U+093F I, U+0940 II, U+0941 U, U+0942 UU. Confirmed locally against Python unicodedata names on 2026-11-19.

Current source shared Rust/Wasm engine built from origin/main f286a16 verifies every displayed pair and the two candidate claims (मीठो offered for mitho; ठिक offered for thik). Results describe this pad only, not a spelling authority. Probe on 2026-11-19 also observed that suggestion lists for chini and nadi did not include चिनी or नदी (absence is not an executable check type, so it is recorded here only).

Authorized Search Console read recorded in the Nov 26 SEO review (evidence/seo/2026-11-26/search-console.json, sc-domain:neptype.com, Web, Oct 28–Nov 24): bare vowel-sign queries 'ी' (8 impressions, avg position 8.1), 'ु' (4 at 8.8), 'ू' (3 at 10.0), no clicks; this page 12 impressions at 8.2 (en) and 8 at 8.5 (ne), no clicks. Query and page rows were read separately, so attribution of these queries to this page is likely but not read. Small sample; supports adding sign-copy and syllable-row help to the existing page, not a new article or any ranking claim.

Code points and names for the listed signs rechecked with Python unicodedata on 2026-11-26: U+093F VOWEL SIGN I, U+0940 VOWEL SIGN II, U+0941 VOWEL SIGN U, U+0942 VOWEL SIGN UU; ई U+0908 LETTER II, ऊ U+090A LETTER UU.

en.title: Check short and long vowels (ि ी ु ू) in Roman Nepali typing | NepType
en.heading: Check short and long vowels when you type Nepali in Roman letters
en.description: Roman i and u do not say whether a Nepali vowel is short or long. See which NepType spellings gave ि or ी in खीर, मीठो and चिनी and how to fix them before copying. The signs ि ी ु ू are listed to copy on their own.
sections: Read the vowel sign after each word

A Roman i can become ि or ी, and u can become ु or ू. NepType picks one from its dictionary, and the first result is not always the spelling you want. In Nepali + EN mode, didi gave दिदी with a short vowel and then a long one, and dudh gave दूध with a long ू. Look at the sign on each word before you move on. These results come from the current pad; another keyboard may give something else.
Copy a vowel sign like ी on its own

No Roman spelling in the pad gave a vowel sign by itself. In Nepali + EN mode, ii gave ई and u gave ऊ, the full vowel letters that stand without a consonant, and a single i stayed in Roman letters. To show a sign alone, in a spelling note for example, copy it from this list and paste it into the Roman box. The pad keeps pasted Devanagari unchanged: ि (U+093F, short i), ी (U+0940, long i), ु (U+0941, short u) and ू (U+0942, long u).

links: Paste the sign into the pad

sections: Type a syllable row such as घ घा घि घी घु घू

For a school chart that puts one letter with each vowel sign, type the syllables with a space between them. gha ghaa ghi ghii ghu ghuu gave घ घा घि घी घु घू, and bha bhaa bhi bhii bhu bhuu gave भ भा भि भी भु भू. Other letters went wrong: ti gave the long ती, and khii gave खिइ, two letters where you wanted one. Click the wrong syllable in the Roman box and pick the right form from the suggestions, ति for ti and खी for khii. A row that starts with ka needs All Nepali mode, where ka kaa ki kii ku kuu gave क का कि की कु कू.

examples: gha ghaa ghi ghii ghu ghuu
घ घा घि घी घु घू
bha bhaa bhi bhii bhu bhuu
भ भा भि भी भु भू
links: Letter rows and the All Nepali mode

sections: Pick the other form from the suggestions

If the first result has the wrong length, look at the suggestion list for that word before typing the next one. For mitho the pad wrote मिठो with a short ि, and मीठो with the long ी was among the suggestions. Click or tap it, or use the number shortcut shown in the typing guide.
Try ee when the long ी is missing

For some words the suggestions did not show the long form you need. In our checks, writing ee gave the long vowel: meetho gave मीठो, chinee gave चिनी and nadee gave नदी. Other words may behave differently, so read each result.
Compare one sentence typed two ways

The difference is easy to miss in a full sentence. Typed with i, the sentence about kheer came out with two short vowels. Typed with ee, both words got the long ी. Before you copy, check every word that has an i or u in it.
Check your reference when the spelling changed

The accepted length of some words has changed between dictionary editions. The Nepali Language Resource Center spell-checker FAQ says earlier editions of the official dictionary listed ठीक, and later ones list only ठिक. NepType wrote ठीक for thik and offered ठिक as a suggestion. Use the form your school, office or dictionary edition expects. NepType does not check spelling against any dictionary edition.

links: Check chandrabindu in the same way

ne.title: ह्रस्व कि दीर्घ? रोमनबाट नेपाली लेख्दा ि, ी, ु र ू जाँच्नुहोस् | NepType
ne.heading: रोमन अक्षरबाट नेपाली लेख्दा ह्रस्व र दीर्घ मात्रा जाँच्नुहोस्
ne.description: रोमनको i र u ले नेपाली स्वर ह्रस्व हो कि दीर्घ भन्दैन। खीर, मीठो र चिनीमा NepType ले कुन हिज्जेबाट ि वा ी दियो र कपी गर्नुअघि कसरी सच्याउने, हेर्नुहोस्। ि ी ु ू मात्रा एक्लै कपी गर्न पनि राखिएको छ।
sections: हरेक शब्दपछि मात्रा पढ्नुहोस्

रोमनको i बाट ि वा ी, र u बाट ु वा ू बन्न सक्छ। NepType ले आफ्नो शब्दकोशबाट एउटा रोज्छ, र पहिलो नतिजा सधैँ तपाईंले चाहेको हिज्जे हुँदैन। Nepali + EN मोडमा didi लेख्दा पहिले ह्रस्व र पछि दीर्घ मात्रासहित दिदी आयो, र dudh लेख्दा दीर्घ ू सहित दूध आयो। अर्को शब्द लेख्नुअघि हरेक शब्दको मात्रा हेर्नुहोस्। यी नतिजा हालको प्याडका हुन्, अर्को किबोर्डमा फरक आउन सक्छ।
ी जस्तो मात्रा एक्लै कपी गर्नुहोस्

प्याडमा कुनै रोमन हिज्जेले मात्रा एक्लै दिएन। Nepali + EN मोडमा ii बाट ई र u बाट ऊ आयो, जुन व्यञ्जनबिना आफैँ लेखिने स्वरवर्ण हुन्, र एउटा i रोमनमै रह्यो। हिज्जेबारे नोट लेख्दा जस्तै मात्रा मात्र देखाउनु परे यो सूचीबाट कपी गरेर रोमन बक्समा पेस्ट गर्नुहोस्। प्याडले पेस्ट गरिएको देवनागरी नबदली राख्छ: ि (U+093F, ह्रस्व इ), ी (U+0940, दीर्घ ई), ु (U+0941, ह्रस्व उ) र ू (U+0942, दीर्घ ऊ)।
घ घा घि घी घु घू जस्तो पङ्क्ति लेख्नुहोस्

एउटै अक्षरमा हरेक मात्रा लगाएको विद्यालयको चार्टका लागि अक्षरहरूबीच स्पेस राखेर लेख्नुहोस्। gha ghaa ghi ghii ghu ghuu बाट घ घा घि घी घु घू, र bha bhaa bhi bhii bhu bhuu बाट भ भा भि भी भु भू आयो। अरू अक्षरमा मिलेन: ti बाट दीर्घ ती आयो, र khii बाट एउटा अक्षरको सट्टा दुई अक्षर खिइ आयो। रोमन बक्समा गलत अक्षरमा थिचेर सुझावबाट सही रूप छान्नुहोस्, ti का लागि ति र khii का लागि खी। ka बाट सुरु हुने पङ्क्तिका लागि All Nepali मोड चाहिन्छ, जहाँ ka kaa ki kii ku kuu बाट क का कि की कु कू आयो।

examples: gha ghaa ghi ghii ghu ghuu
घ घा घि घी घु घू
bha bhaa bhi bhii bhu bhuu
भ भा भि भी भु भू
links: अक्षरका पङ्क्ति र All Nepali मोड

sections: सुझावबाट अर्को रूप छान्नुहोस्

पहिलो नतिजाको मात्रा मिलेन भने अर्को शब्द लेख्नुअघि त्यही शब्दका सुझाव हेर्नुहोस्। mitho लेख्दा प्याडले ह्रस्व ि भएको मिठो लेख्यो, र दीर्घ ी भएको मीठो सुझावमा थियो। त्यसलाई थिचेर वा टाइपिङ गाइडमा भनिएको सर्टकटले छान्नुहोस्।
दीर्घ ी सुझावमा नभए ee लेखेर हेर्नुहोस्
केही शब्दमा चाहिएको दीर्घ रूप सुझावमा देखिएन। हाम्रो जाँचमा ee लेख्दा दीर्घ स्वर आयो: meetho बाट मीठो, chinee बाट चिनी र nadee बाट नदी। अरू शब्दमा यसरी नमिल्न सक्छ, त्यसैले हरेक नतिजा पढ्नुहोस्।
एउटै वाक्य दुई तरिकाले लेखेर दाँज्नुहोस्
पूरा वाक्यमा यो फरक सजिलै छुट्छ। खीरबारेको वाक्य i राखेर लेख्दा दुवै शब्दमा ह्रस्व मात्रा आयो। ee राखेर लेख्दा दुवैमा दीर्घ ी आयो। कपी गर्नुअघि i वा u भएका हरेक शब्द जाँच्नुहोस्।
हिज्जे फेरिएको शब्दमा आफ्नो सन्दर्भ हेर्नुहोस्

केही शब्दको मान्य मात्रा शब्दकोशका संस्करणअनुसार फेरिएको छ। नेपाली भाषा स्रोत केन्द्रको स्पेल चेकर FAQ अनुसार आधिकारिक शब्दकोशका पुराना संस्करणमा ठीक थियो, पछिका संस्करणमा ठिक मात्र छ। NepType ले thik बाट ठीक लेख्यो र ठिक सुझावमा दियो। तपाईंको विद्यालय, कार्यालय वा शब्दकोशको संस्करणले जुन रूप मान्छ त्यही प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्। NepType ले कुनै पनि शब्दकोश संस्करणअनुसार हिज्जे जाँच्दैन।
